plugins.name: software-workflows
plugins.description: Agent-teams orchestration skill — spawn, coordinate, and shut down Claude Code implicit agent teams with correct, schema-validated tool signatures (Agent, TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, SendMessage). Codex cross-model integration with the Independence Protocol: the advisor is dispatched blind, so its agreement is evidence rather than an echo of your own framing.

plugins.name: codex-oracle
plugins.description: Cross-model advisory MCP — Codex (strongest configured OpenAI model, auto-detected from the Codex CLI config; reasoning effort pinned to max, immune to the desktop-app slider) as senior architect/reviewer: architect_review, code_review, research, codex_query. Live web search forced on (web_search=live, not the cached default) with mandatory primary sources; anti-anchoring built in — a caller_hypothesis parameter that is refuted rather than confirmed, plus a lint that flags callers who smuggle a conclusion into the scoping fields. Opt-in infra mode for read-only live-infrastructure investigation. NEW: /abraham write mode — two air-gapped phases: read-only deep analysis (codebase + live infra + live web) produces a brief, then a SEALED implementer (workspace-write file access, no network/web/MCP) carries it out; git preconditions incl. dirty-tree refusal, an authoritative one-writer-per-tree lock, changed-files attribution with HEAD verification, no auto-retry for writes, and ~65% auto-compaction for long implementation runs. Ships hooks that gate plan mode and git push on the Codex review.
